evals.prompt: /tribunal:deliberate --depth full We're migrating our monolith to microservices. DevOps says it saves ops overhead, but our senior engineer worries about debugging complexity and network latency. Cost is neutral over 2 years. Should we go ahead?
evals.expected_output: Structured verdict with five persona positions on microservices migration, weighted consensus, confidence score, and dissent if present

evals.prompt: /tribunal:deliberate --depth full --min-confidence 70 Ship an opt-out telemetry SDK that phones home to analytics. Users can disable it, but it's on by default. Revenue upside is clear; privacy concerns exist but legal says we're compliant. Should we ship?
evals.expected_output: Verdict evaluating ethical/compliance tradeoffs with confidence gate at 70%, panel positions on telemetry, dissent highlighted if below threshold

evals.prompt: /tribunal:deliberate --brief --domain strategic Sunset the free tier in 6 months, require $99/month minimum. Current free users are 40% of usage but <5% of revenue. Keeps operations lean; risks losing dev adoption. Proceed?
evals.expected_output: Brief-depth verdict on free tier sunset, strategic domain focus, weighted consensus on business decision with dissent
